comparison.objective: Power on a bench supply and set its voltage to 9 V; candidate tunes and locks axis damping from observed impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Button pressing and direct knob setting versus key insertion, setscrew unlocking, collar adjustment, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Power latched and voltage within 0.2 V, with arms returned; complete rubric text is not indexed as a spec. Candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both adjust a rotary control, but direct value selection does not test mechanical locking or iterative dynamic commissioning.
